creditAndCorporateFacts.metric: California Jack in the Box Restaurants (as of Sep 28, 2025)
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Brand health is tightly coupled to California wages (AB 1228), consumer health, and LA Basin economics.

creditAndCorporateFacts.metric: Franchise Share of Jack in the Box System (as of Jul 5, 2026)
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Even if corporate is on the master lease, store survival depends on franchisee unit-level profitability.

creditAndCorporateFacts.metric: System Real Estate Ownership & Leasing Breakdown (as of Sep 28, 2025)
creditAndCorporateFacts.value: 164 company-owned land+bldg; 565 company-owned bldg on leased land; 1,020 company-leased bldg+land; 387 franchise direct
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: 74.2% of units involve third-party leases held by Jack in the Box (mostly subleased to franchisees); 18.1% are direct franchisee sites. Private lease abstract MUST confirm whether landlord's lessee is Corporate/SPV or Franchisee.

creditAndCorporateFacts.metric: Standard Real Estate Lease Term & Contingent Rent
creditAndCorporateFacts.value: Initial terms generally 20 yrs; renewal options generally 1–20 yrs at lessee's sole discretion; ~13% include contingent rent (1%–10% of gross sales above threshold)
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Unilateral tenant renewal options cap landlord upside unless renewal rent resets to FMV or option notice is missed.

creditAndCorporateFacts.metric: Series 2026-1 Class A-2 Securitized Refinancing (Closed Jun 23, 2026)
creditAndCorporateFacts.value: $500.0M issued at 7.624% fixed rate (ARD: May 2031; Legal Final: May 2056), refinancing 4.476% 2019-1 and 3.445% 2022-1 notes
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Refinancing removed imminent Aug 2026 maturity wall, but raised coupon by +315 to +418 bps and creates a new May 2031 ARD right inside our 2030–2035 lease expiration window.

creditAndCorporateFacts.metric: Total Carrying Debt, Cash Sweep & Equity Deficit (as of Jul 5, 2026)
creditAndCorporateFacts.value: $1,472.8M carrying debt ($44.2M current + $1,428.7M LT); Senior ABS Leverage >5.25x triggered $23.3M cash-sweep prepayments; Stockholders' deficit $(901.3)M; Cash $46.3M (+$25.5M restricted)
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: High leverage and active cash sweep restrict corporate willingness to fund landlord TIs or subsidize underperforming stores. Next ARDs: Aug 2029 (2019-1 A-2-III), May 2031 (2026-1 A-2), Feb 2032 (2022-1 A-2-II).

creditAndCorporateFacts.value: Common dividend and share repurchases discontinued ($0.00 declared YTD Q3 FY26 vs. $0.88 prior year)
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Management is prioritizing deleveraging over shareholder payouts — prudent for debt holders, confirms tight liquidity posture.

creditAndCorporateFacts.value: Sold to a buyer for $119.1M net proceeds ($47.4M pre-tax loss); $105M used to prepay 2019-1 notes; Delaware Court of Chancery TSA/insurance dispute filed Mar 13, 2026
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Eliminates multi-brand distraction and simplifies Jack in the Box into a single-brand business, though capital loss and post-closing litigation show ongoing restructuring friction.

creditAndCorporateFacts.value: Executive Chair / interim CEO appointment in May 2026; announced CFO, chief legal officer, and CTO departures scheduled across January–May 2027 per the November 2026 filing
creditAndCorporateFacts.landlordImplication: Elevated corporate execution & strategic uncertainty through 2027; lease renewal negotiations may face shifting corporate priorities until permanent CEO/CFO settle in.
